title: Fade a routine or keep retrieving it
statement: Whether a named thinking routine should fade once a stated condition is met, or keep returning as scheduled retrieval.
example: A ruled fade, to a two-step option after five successful uses, was never built.
detail: The reading project's comprehension doctrine holds this as an open dispute: named inference routines as fading scaffolds retired on a stated condition, its own stance, against scheduled recurring retrieval of the routine (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0121-teaching-comprehension-insights-brainlift.qmd`). A course ruling had a procedure collapse into a two-step option after five successful uses, but the course never got past one lesson per scaffold level, so the fade was never built (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0180-lesson-structure-procedure-rulings.qmd`).
